function jotformTabText(tab) {return norm(tab?.querySelector?.('.tab-text')?.textContent || tab?.textContent || '');}

function findJotformVisibleTabByLabel(label) {const wanted = norm(label).toLowerCase();
                                             return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.product-tab-item[role="tab"], .tab-item[role="tab"]'))
                                                .find((tab) => jotformTabText(tab).toLowerCase() === wanted);}

function buildJotformTabDropdown(group,tabs) {const wrap = document.createElement('div');
                                             wrap.className = 'icbincnJotformTabDropdown';
                                             wrap.dataset.icbincnTabGroup = group.key;
                                             const button = document.createElement('button');
                                             button.type = 'button';
                                             button.className = 'icbincnJotformTabDropdownButton';
                                             button.setAttribute('aria-haspopup','true');
                                             button.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
                                             button.textContent = group.title;
                                             const menu = document.createElement('div');
                                             menu.className = 'icbincnJotformTabDropdownMenu';
                                             menu.setAttribute('role','menu');
                                             for (const label of group.labels) {const item = document.createElement('button');
                                                                               item.type = 'button';
                                                                               item.className = 'icbincnJotformTabDropdownItem';
                                                                               item.setAttribute('role','menuitem');
                                                                               item.textContent = label;
                                                                               item.addEventListener('click',(e) => {e.preventDefault();
                                                                                                                       e.stopPropagation();
                                                                                                                       wrap.classList.remove('isOpen');
                                                                                                                       button.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
                                                                                                                       const tab = findJotformVisibleTabByLabel(label);
                                                                                                                       if (tab) tab.click();});
                                                                               menu.appendChild(item);}
                                             button.addEventListener('click',(e) => {e.preventDefault();
                                                                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                                                                    const nextOpen = !wrap.classList.contains('isOpen');
                                                                                    for (const other of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.icbincnJotformTabDropdown.isOpen'))) {if (other !== wrap) {other.classList.remove('isOpen');
                                                                                                                                                                                                            other.querySelector('.icbincnJotformTabDropdownButton')?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}}
                                                                                    wrap.classList.toggle('isOpen',nextOpen);
                                                                                    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(nextOpen));});
                                             wrap.appendChild(button);
                                             wrap.appendChild(menu);
                                             const activeTab = tabs.find((tab) => tab.getAttribute('data-active') === 'true' || tab.classList.contains('active'));
                                             if (activeTab) wrap.classList.add('hasActiveTab');
                                             return wrap;}

function consolidateJotformFilterTabs() {for (const group of JOTFORM_TAB_DROPDOWN_GROUPS) {const tabs = group.labels.map(findJotformVisibleTabByLabel).filter(Boolean);
                                                                                         if (!tabs.length) continue;
                                                                                         const firstTab = tabs[0];
                                                                                         const parent = firstTab.parentElement;
                                                                                         if (!parent) continue;
                                                                                         let dropdown = parent.querySelector(`.icbincnJotformTabDropdown[data-icbincn-tab-group="${group.key}"]`);
                                                                                         if (!dropdown) {dropdown = buildJotformTabDropdown(group,tabs);
                                                                                                         parent.insertBefore(dropdown,firstTab);}
                                                                                         dropdown.classList.toggle('hasActiveTab',tabs.some((tab) => tab.getAttribute('data-active') === 'true' || tab.classList.contains('active')));
                                                                                         for (const tab of tabs) {tab.classList.add('icbincnJotformTabHidden');
                                                                                                                   tab.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');}}}

function initializeJotformTabConsolidation() {consolidateJotformFilterTabs();
                                             document.addEventListener('click',(e) => {if (e.target?.closest?.('.icbincnJotformTabDropdown')) return;
                                                                                      for (const dropdown of Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.icbincnJotformTabDropdown.isOpen'))) {dropdown.classList.remove('isOpen');
                                                                                                                                                                                          dropdown.querySelector('.icbincnJotformTabDropdownButton')?.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');}},true);}

function injectJotformSearchButtons() {const statusColumnId = findJotformColumnIdByTitle('Status');
                                      const wrappers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.jSheetRow-cellWrapper'))
                                            .filter((w) => statusColumnId ? w.dataset?.columnId === statusColumnId : jotformHeaderTitleByQid(w.dataset?.columnId).toLowerCase() === 'status');

                                                                      const nameWrapper = getJotformNameWrapperForRowWrapper(wrapper);

                                                                      const btn = document.createElement('button');
                                                                      btn.type = 'button';
                                                                      btn.className = 'icbincnJotformSearchBtn';
                                                                      btn.title = 'Run ICBiNCn Case.net name search for this row';
                                                                      btn.setAttribute('aria-label','Run ICBiNCn search with Casey');
                                                                      const img = document.createElement('img');
                                                                      img.alt = 'Casey';
                                                                      img.src = ICBINCN_CASEY_LOGO_DATA_URL;
                                                                      btn.appendChild(img);
                                                                      btn.addEventListener('click',(e) => {e.preventDefault();
                                                                                                           e.stopPropagation();
                                                                                                           try {const params = getJotformParamsForNameWrapper(nameWrapper);
                                                                                                                startIcbincnSearchFromJotform(params);
                                                                                                                btn.classList.add('isOpening');
                                                                                                                setTimeout(() => {btn.classList.remove('isOpening');},2500);}
                                                                                                           catch (err) {btn.classList.add('isError');
                                                                                                                        setTimeout(() => {btn.classList.remove('isError');},2500);
                                                                                                                        alert(`ICBiNCn Search: ${String(err?.message || err)}`);}});
                                                                      wrapper.appendChild(btn);}}

const JOTFORM_TARGET_GROUP_NAME = 'Status';
const JOTFORM_GROUP_REMOVE_CLICK_COOLDOWN_MS = 750;
const JOTFORM_FILTER_RESULT_CLOSE_CLICK_COOLDOWN_MS = 750;
let jotformLastGroupRemoveClickTime = 0;
let jotformLastFilterResultCloseClickTime = 0;

function normalizeJotformGroupingText(text) {return String(text || '')
                                                   .replace(/\s+/g,' ')
                                                   .trim()
                                                   .toLowerCase();}

function isVisibleJotformGroupingControl(el) {if (!el) return false;
                                             const style = window.getComputedStyle(el);
                                             const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                                             return style.display !== 'none' &&
                                                    style.visibility !== 'hidden' &&
                                                    style.opacity !== '0' &&
                                                    rect.width > 0 &&
                                                    rect.height > 0;}

function removeJotformGroupedByStatus() {const groupingElements = document.querySelectorAll('.js-groupBy.forGrouping, .js-groupBy');
                                        for (const groupingElement of groupingElements) {const text = normalizeJotformGroupingText(groupingElement.textContent);
                                                                                          const isGroupedByElement = text.includes('grouped by') || text.includes('grouped bystatus');
                                                                                          const isStatusGrouping = text.includes(JOTFORM_TARGET_GROUP_NAME.toLowerCase());
                                                                                          if (!isGroupedByElement || !isStatusGrouping) continue;
                                                                                          const removeButton = groupingElement.querySelector('button.js-removeGrouping, button[aria-label="Remove grouping"], .jSheetRemove');
                                                                                          if (!removeButton || !isVisibleJotformGroupingControl(removeButton)) continue;
                                                                                          const now = Date.now();

                                                                                          removeButton.click();

                                                                                          return;}}

function isJotformBrandingTextNode(node) {if (!node || node.nodeType !== Node.TEXT_NODE || norm(node.nodeValue) !== 'Jotform') return false;
                                         const parent = node.parentElement;
                                         if (!parent || parent.closest?.('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"],.jSheetRow,.jSheetRow-cellWrapper,.jfSpreadsheet,.jSheetTable')) return false;
                                         const rect = parent.getBoundingClientRect?.();
                                         if (!rect || rect.width <= 0 || rect.height <= 0) return false;
                                         if (rect.left > 360 || rect.top > 180) return false;
                                         const ancestry = [];
                                         for (let el = parent; el && el !== document.body && ancestry.length < 6; el = el.parentElement) {ancestry.push(`${el.className || ''} ${el.id || ''} ${el.getAttribute?.('aria-label') || ''} ${el.getAttribute?.('title') || ''} ${el.getAttribute?.('href') || ''}`);}
                                         const haystack = ancestry.join(' ').toLowerCase();
                                         return /logo|brand|header|navbar|topbar|app-header|jf/.test(haystack);}

function jotformNotformLogoDataUrl() {const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="156" height="32" viewBox="0 0 156 32" role="img" aria-label="Notform Logo"><text x="0" y="24" fill="#0a1551" font-family="Inter, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700">Notform</text></svg>`;
                                  return `data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;}

function updateJotformBrandingLogoImages(root = document.body) {if (!root) return;
                                                              const selector = 'img.jfLogo,img[src*="jotform-logo"],img[alt*="JotForm"],img[alt*="Jotform"],img[aria-label*="JotForm"],img[aria-label*="Jotform"],img[title*="JotForm"],img[title*="Jotform"]';
                                                              const candidates = root.matches?.(selector) ? [root] : Array.from(root.querySelectorAll?.(selector) || []);
                                                              for (const img of candidates) {const src = img.getAttribute('src') || '';
                                                                                             const alt = img.getAttribute('alt') || '';
                                                                                             const title = img.getAttribute('title') || '';
                                                                                             const aria = img.getAttribute('aria-label') || '';
                                                                                             const haystack = `${img.className || ''} ${src} ${alt} ${title} ${aria}`.toLowerCase();
                                                                                             if (!/jotform|jflogo|jotform-logo/.test(haystack)) continue;
                                                                                             img.setAttribute('src',jotformNotformLogoDataUrl());
                                                                                             img.setAttribute('alt','Notform Logo');
                                                                                             if (title) img.setAttribute('title',title.replace(/JotForm|Jotform/g,'Notform'));
                                                                                             if (aria) img.setAttribute('aria-label',aria.replace(/JotForm|Jotform/g,'Notform'));
                                                                                             img.dataset.icbincnNotformLogo = 'true';}}

function updateJotformBrandingText(root = document.body) {if (!root) return;
                                            updateJotformBrandingLogoImages(root);
                                            const attrElements = root.querySelectorAll?.('[aria-label*="Jotform"],[aria-label*="JotForm"],[title*="Jotform"],[title*="JotForm"],[alt*="Jotform"],[alt*="JotForm"]') || [];
                                            for (const el of Array.from(attrElements)) {for (const attr of ['aria-label','title','alt']) {const value = el.getAttribute(attr);
                                                                                                                                          if (value && /JotForm|Jotform/.test(value)) el.setAttribute(attr,value.replace(/JotForm|Jotform/g,'Notform'));}}
                                            const walker = document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,{acceptNode(node) {return isJotformBrandingTextNode(node) ? NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT : NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;}});
                                            const matches = [];
                                            for (let node = walker.nextNode(); node; node = walker.nextNode()) matches.push(node);
                                            for (const node of matches) node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue.replace(/Jotform/g,'Notform');}

function initializeJotformBrandingReplacement() {updateJotformBrandingText();
                                               const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {for (const mutation of mutations) {if (mutation.type === 'characterData') {const node = mutation.target;
                                                                                                                                               if (isJotformBrandingTextNode(node)) node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue.replace(/Jotform/g,'Notform');}
                                                                                                      for (const node of Array.from(mutation.addedNodes || [])) {if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {if (isJotformBrandingTextNode(node)) node.nodeValue = node.nodeValue.replace(/Jotform/g,'Notform');}
                                                                                                                                                                      else if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) updateJotformBrandingText(node);}}});
                                               observer.observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});
                                               setInterval(updateJotformBrandingText,2000);}

/************************************************************
 * Weekly Call Log: one injected Casey button + completion-only Apps Script writer
 ************************************************************/
const WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID = '1TPCAM7rJ9e_YDLrgI4YfjOq_QXZFfo6Sj6c9g9qPth4';
const WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID = 1261396864;
const KEY_SHEETS_RESULTS = 'mo_casenet_weekly_call_log_results_v1';
const SHEETS_BRIDGE_CHANNEL = 'icbincn-weekly-call-log-v1';
const WEEKLY_CASEY_LOGO = 'data:image/png;base64,';

function isWeeklyCallLogSpreadsheet() {
  return location.hostname === 'docs.google.com' &&
    location.pathname.startsWith(`/spreadsheets/d/${WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID}/`);
}

function parseWeeklyCallLogLaunch(hash) {
  const query = new URLSearchParams(String(hash || '').replace(/^#/, ''));
  if (query.get('icbincn') !== 'weekly-call-log') return null;
  const row = Number(query.get('row'));
  const params = {first:norm(query.get('first')),middle:'',last:norm(query.get('last')),yob:norm(query.get('yob'))};
  if (query.get('spreadsheet') !== WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID || Number(query.get('gid')) !== WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(row) || row < 4 || !params.first || !params.last || !/^(19|20)\d{2}$/.test(params.yob)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid Weekly Call Log link. Check FN, LN, and DOB, then refresh Casey links.');
  }
  return {spreadsheetId:WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID,sheetId:WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID,row,params};
}

function consumeWeeklyCallLogLaunch() {
  if (location.hostname !== 'www.courts.mo.gov' || !location.pathname.startsWith('/casenet/')) return;
  let launch;
  try {launch = parseWeeklyCallLogLaunch(location.hash);}
  catch (error) {uiStatus(error.message); return;}
  if (!launch) return;
  // Consume once; subsequent pass navigations use the existing state machine.
  history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname + location.search);
  try {startWeeklyCallLogSearch(launch,false);}
  catch (error) {uiStatus(error.message);}
}

function startWeeklyCallLogSearch(input,openCourtTab = true) {
  const launch = {spreadsheetId:input?.spreadsheetId,sheetId:input?.sheetId,row:input?.row,
    params:{first:norm(input?.params?.first),middle:'',last:norm(input?.params?.last),yob:norm(input?.params?.yob)}};
  if (launch.spreadsheetId !== WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID || launch.sheetId !== WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(launch.row) || launch.row < 4 || !launch.params.first || !launch.params.last ||
      !/^(19|20)\d{2}$/.test(launch.params.yob)) throw new Error('Casey needs a first name in N, last name in O, and valid birth year in Q on this row.');
  if (loadNameState()?.active || isRun() || loadTrackState()?.active) {
    throw new Error('Another Casey search is running. Wait for completion, then click Casey again.');
  }
  const requestId = typeof crypto.randomUUID === 'function' ? crypto.randomUUID() : `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
  setStop(false);
  setRun(false);
  saveDraft(launch.params);
  saveLog([]);
  saveDebug([]);
  clearLastHtml();
  saveJson(KEY_NET_STATS,{byPath:{}});
  saveNameState({active:true,passIndex:0,passes:buildNameSearchPasses(launch.params),step:'go_search',
    params:launch.params,casenetAddedTotal:0,autoMinimized:false,launchedFrom:'weekly-call-log',
    sheetsPending:{...launch,requestId},launchedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
  setIcbincnTabTitleText('Searching (1/3)');
  if (openCourtTab && !openBackgroundTab('https://www.courts.mo.gov/casenet/nameSearch.do?newSearch=Y',{requireBackground:true})) {
    clearNameState();
    throw new Error('Could not open the court tab. Enable Tampermonkey background-tab access and try again.');
  }
}

function persistWeeklyCallLogResult(state) {
  if (isStop()) return;
  const pending = state?.sheetsPending;
  if (!pending?.requestId) return;
  const results = loadJson(KEY_SHEETS_RESULTS,{});
  results[pending.requestId] = {...pending,summary:buildSummaryCopyText(),copy:buildGroupedCopyText(),
    completedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
  saveJson(KEY_SHEETS_RESULTS,results);
}

function weeklyCallLogSelectedRow(address) {
  const match=String(address || '').trim().toUpperCase().match(/^BA([1-9]\d*)$/);
  const row=match?Number(match[1]):0;
  return Number.isSafeInteger(row)&&row>=4?row:0;
}

function parseWeeklyCallLogQuery(text,row) {
  const match=String(text).match(/setResponse\(([\s\S]*)\);?\s*$/);
  if(!match)throw new Error('Sheets returned an unreadable response. Check that you are signed in.');
  const data=JSON.parse(match[1]);
  if(data.status!=='ok')throw new Error('Could not read this row from Sheets.');
  const cells=data.table?.rows?.[0]?.c || [];
  const first=norm(cells[0]?.v),last=norm(cells[1]?.v);
  const dob=cells[3];let yob='';
  const date=String(dob?.v || '').match(/^Date\((\d{4}),/);
  if(date)yob=date[1];
  else if(typeof dob?.v==='number') {
    yob=dob.v>=1900&&dob.v<=2099&&Number.isInteger(dob.v)?String(dob.v):String(new Date(Date.UTC(1899,11,30)+dob.v*86400000).getUTCFullYear());
  } else yob=String(dob?.v || dob?.f || '').match(/\b(?:19|20)\d{2}\b/)?.[0] || '';
  if(!first||!last||!/^(19|20)\d{2}$/.test(yob))throw new Error(`Row ${row} needs a first name in N, last name in O, and valid DOB/birth year in Q.`);
  return {spreadsheetId:WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID,sheetId:WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID,row,params:{first,last,middle:'',yob}};
}

async function readWeeklyCallLogRow(row) {
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(row)||row<4)throw new Error('Select a single BA cell in a client row.');
  // Four cells, only on click. Use the existing signed-in Sheets session.
  const query=new URLSearchParams({gid:String(WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID),range:`N${row}:Q${row}`,headers:'0',tqx:'out:json',_casey:String(Date.now())});
  const controller=new AbortController();const timeout=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),10000);
  try {
    const response=await fetch(`/spreadsheets/d/${WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID}/gviz/tq?${query}`,{credentials:'include',cache:'no-store',signal:controller.signal});
    if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`Sheets row read failed (${response.status}).`);
    return parseWeeklyCallLogQuery(await response.text(),row);
  } finally {clearTimeout(timeout);}
}

function initializeWeeklyCallLogBridge() {
  hideIcbincnDockOnJotform();
  let connection=null;
  const deliver=()=>{
    if(!connection)return;
    const results=Object.values(loadJson(KEY_SHEETS_RESULTS,{})).filter(result=>result.spreadsheetId===WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID&&result.sheetId===WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID);
    try {connection.source.postMessage({channel:SHEETS_BRIDGE_CHANNEL,nonce:connection.nonce,type:'results',results},connection.origin);}
    catch {connection=null;}
  };
  window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
    if(!/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9-]+\.googleusercontent\.com$/.test(event.origin)||!event.source||event.source===window)return;
    const message=event.data;
    if(!message||message.channel!==SHEETS_BRIDGE_CHANNEL||message.spreadsheetId!==WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_ID||message.sheetId!==WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID||typeof message.nonce!=='string'||message.nonce.length<16)return;
    if(message.type==='connect'||message.type==='poll'){
      connection={source:event.source,origin:event.origin,nonce:message.nonce};deliver();
    } else if(message.type==='ack'&&connection&&event.source===connection.source&&message.nonce===connection.nonce&&typeof message.requestId==='string'){
      const results=loadJson(KEY_SHEETS_RESULTS,{});delete results[message.requestId];saveJson(KEY_SHEETS_RESULTS,results);
    }
  });
  if(typeof GM_addValueChangeListener==='function')GM_addValueChangeListener(KEY_SHEETS_RESULTS,deliver);
  // No Apps Script invocation is involved in reading the row or starting search.
  installWeeklyCallLogButton(()=>Boolean(connection));
}

function installWeeklyCallLogButton(isConnected) {
  const button=document.createElement('button');
  button.id='icbincnWeeklyCasey';button.type='button';button.hidden=true;
  const image=document.createElement('img');image.src=WEEKLY_CASEY_LOGO;image.alt='Casey';button.appendChild(image);
  document.body.appendChild(button);
  GM_addStyle('#icbincnWeeklyCasey{position:fixed;z-index:100001;width:30px;height:30px;padding:0;border:2px solid #1d4ed8;border-radius:50%;background:white;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #0003}#icbincnWeeklyCasey[hidden]{display:none}#icbincnWeeklyCasey img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%}#icbincnWeeklyCasey:disabled{opacity:.6}');
  const nameBox=()=>document.querySelector('#t-name-box input, input#t-name-box, #t-name-box, input.waffle-name-box');
  const activeTab=()=>new URLSearchParams(location.hash.replace(/^#/,'' )).get('gid') || new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('gid');
  let busy=false;
  const update=()=>{
    if(document.hidden)return;
    const box=nameBox();const row=weeklyCallLogSelectedRow(box?.value);
    const visible=activeTab()===String(WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID)&&row&&document.activeElement!==box;
    button.hidden=!visible;
    if(!visible)return;
    button.dataset.row=String(row);button.title=`Search row ${row} with Casey`;button.setAttribute('aria-label',`Search row ${row} with Casey`);
    const selected=document.querySelector('.active-cell-border');
    const rect=selected?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const anchor=rect&&rect.width>=30&&rect.height>=30&&rect.bottom>0&&rect.right>0?rect:box.getBoundingClientRect();
    const left=anchor===rect?anchor.right-32:anchor.right+4;
    const top=anchor===rect?anchor.top+2:anchor.top;
    button.style.left=`${Math.max(0,Math.min(innerWidth-32,left))}px`;
    button.style.top=`${Math.max(0,Math.min(innerHeight-32,top))}px`;
  };
  button.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>event.preventDefault());
  button.addEventListener('click',async event=>{
    event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();if(busy)return;
    const row=weeklyCallLogSelectedRow(nameBox()?.value);
    if(activeTab()!==String(WEEKLY_CALL_LOG_GID)||!row){alert('Select a single BA cell in Weekly Call Log.');return;}
    if(!isConnected()){alert('Open Casey → Connect search results once so BB/BC can be filled, then click Casey again.');return;}
    busy=true;button.disabled=true;
    try {const launch=await readWeeklyCallLogRow(row);startWeeklyCallLogSearch(launch);button.title=`Searching row ${row} in the background`;}
    catch(error){alert(`Casey: ${error.name==='AbortError'?'Sheets row read timed out. Try again.':error.message}`);}
    finally {busy=false;button.disabled=false;}
  });
  document.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>requestAnimationFrame(update),true);
  document.addEventListener('keyup',()=>requestAnimationFrame(update),true);
  window.addEventListener('resize',update);window.addEventListener('hashchange',update);
  setInterval(update,600);update();
}

                                     if (action === 'chooseStaff') {if (textBuilderState.data.workflow === 'initial') return textBuilderSet('message',{staff:value}); if (textBuilderState.data.workflow === 'followUpNewCourtDate') return textBuilderSet('courts',{staff:value,courts:[]}); if (textBuilderState.data.workflow === 'walkInDropIn') return textBuilderSet('eligibleDropin',{staff:value}); return textBuilderSet('researchType',{staff:value});}
                                     if (action === 'chooseResearchType') {if (value === 'Nothing Found') return textBuilderSet('message',{researchType:value}); if (value === 'CanDo: Everything' || value === 'CanDo + Can’tDo') return textBuilderSet('courts',{researchType:value,courts:[]}); if (value === 'Can’tDo: Private Attorney') return textBuilderSet('privateAttorneyDropin',{researchType:value}); if (value === 'Can’tDo: Out of Network' || value === 'Can’tDo: Repeat Attempt') return textBuilderSet('ineligibleDropin',{researchType:value,ineligiblePlaceholder:'Enter summary of ineligible cases'}); if (value === 'Can’tDo: Fresh Start Friday') return textBuilderSet('ineligibleDropin',{researchType:value,ineligiblePlaceholder:'Enter summary of Fresh Start Friday cases'}); if (value === 'Can’tDo: Initial Warrant') return textBuilderSet('ineligibleDropin',{researchType:value,ineligiblePlaceholder:"Enter summary of case(s) in 'initial warrant' status"}); if (value === 'Can’tDo: Recent FTA, Not a Warrant Yet') return textBuilderSet('ineligibleDropin',{researchType:value,ineligiblePlaceholder:'Enter summary of cases with a recent Failure to Appear'});}
                                     if (action === 'confirmEligible') return textBuilderState.data.workflow === 'walkInDropIn' ? textBuilderSet('ineligibleDropin',{ineligiblePlaceholder:'Enter summary of ineligible cases'}) : (textBuilderState.data.researchType === 'CanDo + Can’tDo' ? textBuilderSet('multipleReasons',{multipleReasons:[]}) : textBuilderSet(textBuilderNeedsSeatbeltViolations() ? 'seatbeltViolations' : 'address'));
                                     if (action === 'confirmSeatbeltViolations') return textBuilderSet('address');
                                     if (action === 'confirmIneligible') {if (['Can’tDo: Initial Warrant','Can’tDo: Recent FTA, Not a Warrant Yet'].includes(textBuilderState.data.researchType)) return textBuilderSet('courts',{courts:[]}); if (textBuilderState.data.workflow === 'walkInDropIn' || ['Can’tDo: Out of Network','Can’tDo: Repeat Attempt','Can’tDo: Fresh Start Friday'].includes(textBuilderState.data.researchType)) return textBuilderSet('message'); if (textBuilderState.data.researchType === 'CanDo + Can’tDo') return textBuilderSet('address'); return textBuilderSet('courts',{courts:[]});}
                                     if (action === 'confirmPrivateAttorney') return textBuilderSet('remainingIneligibleDropin');
                                     if (action === 'confirmRemainingIneligible') return textBuilderSet('courts',{courts:[]});
                                     if (action === 'toggleCourt') {const courts = new Set(textBuilderState.data.courts || []); courts.has(value) ? courts.delete(value) : courts.add(value); textBuilderState.data.courts = [...courts]; return renderTextBuilder();}
                                     if (action === 'confirmCourts') {if (textBuilderState.data.workflow === 'followUpNewCourtDate') return textBuilderSet((textBuilderState.data.courts || []).includes('Florissant') ? 'newCourtDateSeatbelt' : 'newCourtDateInput',{newCourtDateSeatbeltSummary:''}); if (textBuilderState.data.researchType === 'Can’tDo: Recent FTA, Not a Warrant Yet') return textBuilderSet('ftaDateInput'); if (['CanDo: Everything','CanDo + Can’tDo'].includes(textBuilderState.data.researchType)) return textBuilderSet('eligibleDropin'); if (['Can’tDo: Private Attorney','Can’tDo: Initial Warrant'].includes(textBuilderState.data.researchType)) return textBuilderSet('message'); return textBuilderSet('address');}
                                     if (action === 'chooseAddress') return value === 'Have Address' ? textBuilderSet('addressInput',{addressMode:value}) : textBuilderSet('message',{addressMode:value});
                                     if (action === 'chooseFollowUp') {if (value === 'Legal Aid Resources') return textBuilderSet('legalAidResources',{workflow:'legalAidResources'}); if (value === 'New Court Date') return textBuilderSet('staff',{workflow:'followUpNewCourtDate'}); return textBuilderSet('followUpReadyDay',{workflow:'followUpReady'});}
                                     if (action === 'chooseLegalAidCategory') return textBuilderSet('legalAidResourceOptions',{legalAidCategory:value});
                                     if (action === 'chooseLegalAidResource') return textBuilderSet('legalAidMessage',{legalAidResource:value});
                                     if (action === 'chooseFollowUpReadyDay') return textBuilderSet('message',{followUpDay:value});
                                     if (action === 'chooseNewCourtDateSeatbelt') return textBuilderSet(value === 'Yes' ? 'newCourtDateSeatbeltInput' : 'newCourtDateInput',{newCourtDateSeatbeltSummary:''});
                                     if (action === 'confirmNewCourtDateSeatbelt') return textBuilderSet('newCourtDateInput');
                                     if (action === 'confirmNewCourtDate' || action === 'confirmFtaDate' || action === 'confirmAddress') return textBuilderSet('message');
                                     if (action === 'copyMessage') {const key = textBuilderState.data.workflow === 'walkInDropIn' ? (String(textBuilderState.data.eligibleCases || '').trim() ? 'eligibleCaseDataVisible' : 'ineligibleCaseDataVisible') : 'caseDataVisible'; GM_setClipboard(textBuilderFormatCaseData(textBuilderBuildMessage(),key),'text'); return uiStatus('Text Builder message copied to clipboard');}

                                     if (action === 'copyEligibleMessage') {GM_setClipboard(textBuilderFormatCaseData(textBuilderDropInEligibleMessage(false),'eligibleCaseDataVisible'),'text'); return uiStatus('Text Builder eligible cases message copied to clipboard');}});

  dock.addEventListener('keydown',(event) => {
    if (event.altKey || !(event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)) return;
    const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
    if (key === 'z' || (key === 'y' && !event.shiftKey)) handleNameOutputUndo(event,key === 'y' || event.shiftKey);
  });

  dock.addEventListener('beforeinput',(event) => {
    if (event.cancelable && ['historyUndo','historyRedo'].includes(event.inputType)) handleNameOutputUndo(event,event.inputType === 'historyRedo');
  });

  async function nameSearchTick() {if (/municourt\.net$/i.test(location.hostname || '')) return;
                                 const st = loadNameState();
                                 if (!st?.active) return;
                                 if (st.navPendingUntil && Date.now() < Number(st.navPendingUntil)) return;
                                 if (isRun()) return;
                                 if (isStop()) return;
                                 const pass = (st.passes || [])[st.passIndex || 0];
                                 const passKey = typeof pass === 'string' ? pass : pass?.caseType;
                                 const passMiddle = typeof pass === 'string' ? (st.params?.middle || '') : (pass?.middle || '');
                                 const passLabel = typeof pass === 'string' ? passKey : (pass?.label || passKey);
                                 if (!passKey) {setIcbincnTabTitleText('Searching (3/3)');
                                                uiStatus('Preparing pass 3/3 (Municourt)');
                                                render();
                                                st.prepareStartedAt = 0;
                                                saveNameState(st);
                                                if (st.step === 'municourt_finalizing') {const age = Date.now() - Number(st.finalizingStartedAt || 0);
                                                                                          if (age < 120000) return;
                                                                                          dbg('namesearch_municourt_final_pass_stale_reset',{ageMs: age});
                                                                                          st.step = 'go_search';
                                                                                          st.finalizingStartedAt = 0;
                                                                                          saveNameState(st);}
                                                st.step = 'municourt_finalizing';
                                                st.finalizingStartedAt = Date.now();
                                                saveNameState(st);
                                                let muniAdded = 0;
                                                try {uiStatus('Reading Municourt...');
                                                     render();
                                                     const nextLog = loadLog();
                                                     const muniEntries = await searchMunicourtEntriesByName(st.params || {});
                                                     if (isStop() || loadNameState()?.finalizingStartedAt !== st.finalizingStartedAt) return;
                                                     for (const m of muniEntries) {if (!m?.caseKey) continue;
                                                                                 if (nextLog.some((x) => x.caseKey === m.caseKey)) continue;
                                                                                 nextLog.push(withPleadAndPayTotal(m));
                                                                                 muniAdded += 1;}
                                                     saveLog(nextLog);
                                                     dbg('namesearch_municourt_final_pass_done',{count: muniAdded});}
                                                catch (e) {dbg('namesearch_municourt_final_pass_error',{msg:String(e?.message || e)});}
                                                if (isStop() || loadNameState()?.finalizingStartedAt !== st.finalizingStartedAt) return;
                                                const casenetAdded = Number(st.casenetAddedTotal || 0);
                                                dbg('namesearch_done',{casenetAdded,muniAdded});
                                                if (st.launchedFrom === 'weekly-call-log') {try {persistWeeklyCallLogResult(st);}
                                                                                           catch (e) {dbg('weekly_call_log_result_error',{msg:String(e?.message || e)});}}
                                                if (st.launchedFrom === 'jotform') {try {jotformPersistSearchResult(st);}
                                                                                    catch (e) {dbg('jotform_result_persist_error',{msg:String(e?.message || e)});}}
                                                setIcbincnTabTitleText('Complete');
                                                saveNameSearchOutput({summary:buildSummaryCopyText() || '',copy:buildGroupedCopyText() || ''});
                                                appView = 'name';
                                                clearNameState();
                                                expandDock();
                                                uiStatus(`Done. Case.net: ${casenetAdded}  Municourt.net: ${muniAdded}`);
                                                render();
                                                return;}
                                 if (isNameSearchPage()) {if (st.step === 'submitted_waiting_results') {const age = Date.now() - Number(st.submittedAt || 0);
                                                                                                        if (age < 6000) return;
                                                                                                        dbg('namesearch_resubmit',{passKey,ageMs:age});
                                                                                                        st.step = 'go_search';
                                                                                                        saveNameState(st);}
                                                          const prepMessages = ['Preparing pass 1/3 (criminal)','Preparing pass 2/3 (traffic/municipal)','Preparing pass 3/3 (Municourt)'];
                                                          const prepLabel = prepMessages[st.passIndex || 0] || `Preparing pass (${(st.passIndex || 0) + 1}/3)`;
                                                          setIcbincnTabTitleText(`Searching (${Math.min(3,(Number(st.passIndex || 0) + 1))}/3)`);
                                                          uiStatus(prepLabel);
                                                          render();
                                                          st.prepareStartedAt = 0;
                                                          saveNameState(st);
                                                          dbg('namesearch_submit',{passKey,passMiddle});
                                                          fillNameSearchForm({...st.params,middle: passMiddle},passKey);
                                                          const ok = submitNameSearchForm();
                                                          if (!ok) {uiStatus('Search failed, refresh page and retry');
                                                                    dbg('namesearch_submit_failed',{passKey});
                                                                    return;}
                                                          st.step = 'submitted_waiting_results';
                                                          st.submittedAt = Date.now();
                                                          saveNameState(st);
                                                          return;}
                                 if (isNameSearchResultsPage()) {if (st.step === 'pulling_results') {const age = Date.now() - Number(st.pullStartedAt || 0);
                                                                                                      if (age < 120000) return;
                                                                                                      dbg('namesearch_pull_stale_reset',{passKey,ageMs:age});
                                                                                                      st.step = 'go_search';
                                                                                                      st.pullStartedAt = 0;
                                                                                                      saveNameState(st);}
                                                                if (Number(st.resultsRetryAfter || 0) > Date.now()) return;
                                                                setShowEntriesTo100();
                                                                const dockYob = document.getElementById('moNsYob');
                                                                if (dockYob) dockYob.value = st.params?.yob || '';
                                                                dbg('namesearch_pull_begin',{passKey});
                                                                st.step = 'pulling_results';
                                                                st.pullStartedAt = Date.now();
                                                                saveNameState(st);
                                                                let pullStats = null;
                                                                try {pullStats = await pullJsonFromResultsPage();}
                                                                catch (e) {dbg('namesearch_pull_fatal',{passKey,msg:String(e?.message || e)});
                                                                           setRun(false);}
                                                                const pullStatus = pullStats?.status || 'error';
                                                                st.casenetAddedTotal = Number(st.casenetAddedTotal || 0) + Number(pullStats?.appendedCount || 0);
                                                                dbg('namesearch_pull_done',{passKey,status:pullStatus,appendedCount:Number(pullStats?.appendedCount || 0)});
                                                                if (pullStatus !== 'complete' && pullStatus !== 'no_matches') {st.step = 'go_search';
                                                                                                                                 st.pullStartedAt = 0;
                                                                                                                                 st.prepareStartedAt = Date.now();
                                                                                                                                 st.resultsRetryAfter = Date.now() + 5000;
                                                                                                                                 saveNameState(st);
                                                                                                                                 uiStatus('Results are still loading; retrying this pass…');
                                                                                                                                 render();
                                                                                                                                 return;}
                                                                st.passIndex = (st.passIndex || 0) + 1;
                                                                setIcbincnTabTitleText(`Searching (${Math.min(3,(Number(st.passIndex || 0) + 1))}/3)`);
                                                                st.step = 'go_search';
                                                                st.pullStartedAt = 0;
                                                                st.prepareStartedAt = Date.now();
                                                                st.navPendingUntil = Date.now() + 3000;
                                                                st.resultsRetryAfter = 0;
                                                                saveNameState(st);
                                                                location.href = canonicalNameSearchUrl();
                                                                return;}
                                 location.href = canonicalNameSearchUrl();}
/************************************************************
 * INIT
 ************************************************************/
if (isWeeklyCallLogSpreadsheet()) {initializeWeeklyCallLogBridge();}
else if (isJotformTablesPage()) {initializeJotformIntegration();}
else {startIcbincnTabBrandingObserver();
      consumeWeeklyCallLogLaunch();
      uiStatus(getStatus() || 'Ready');
      restoreActiveNameSearchUiOnLoad();
      render();

      let nameSearchTickInFlight = false;
      const kickNameSearchTick = () => {if (nameSearchTickInFlight) return;
                                       nameSearchTickInFlight = true;
                                       Promise.resolve(nameSearchTick()).catch(() => {}).finally(() => {nameSearchTickInFlight = false;});};
      // Run once at page initialization so background-tab timer throttling cannot
      // stall the next pass. The interval remains only as a recovery watchdog.
      kickNameSearchTick();
      window.addEventListener('pageshow',kickNameSearchTick);
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',() => {if (!document.hidden) kickNameSearchTick();});
      setInterval(() => {kickNameSearchTick();
                         try {trackTick();}
                         catch (e) {}},900);}})();
